changelog:
Initial release of agent-relay: a bridge between AI agents and phones, featuring push notification delivery with polling fallback.

- Push-first webhook architecture with polling for reliable message delivery.
- Supports text, attachments (images/files), and standalone push notifications.
- CLI tools for sending/receiving messages and notifications.
- Full documentation and template configs for easy OpenClaw integration.
- Includes transform scripts for secure attachment handling.
- Polling fallback ensures no messages are lost if webhooks fail.
summary: Bridge between an AI agent and a phone — send/receive messages with attachments and push notifications. Push-first webhook architecture with polling fallback.
